caseName: Levin v. Mississippi River Fuel Corp.
caseNameFull: Levin v. Mississippi River Fuel Corp. and Alleghany Corp. v. Mississippi River Fuel Corp.
attorneys: Maxwell Brandwen and John Lowenthal for petitioner in No. 352., Breck P. McAllister and William E. Haudek for petitioners in No. 359., R. H. McRoberts and John H. opinions.text:
